title: (0Day) Genesis World decompress_usdz Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Genesis World. Interaction with this library is required to exploit this vulnerability but attack vectors may vary depending on the implementation.
The specific flaw exists within the decompress_usdz function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user.
addtionnal_details:
07/16/26 - ZDI emailed a Genesis World contributor to request a secure channel for vulnerability disclosures07/28/26 - ZDI asked the vendor to update their security policy via a GitHub issue07/28/26 - the vendor closed the issue08/06/26 - ZDI followed up requesting the vendor’s PSIRT contacts 09/11/26 - ZDI notified the vendor of the intention to publish the case as a 0-day advisory
-- Mitigation: Given the nature of the vulnerability, the only salient mitigation strategy is to restrict interaction with the product
